# Test fixtures

- `zip/assinado_backend.zip` + `zip/assinado_backend.pub`: contract package signed by the real SCORM Maker backend code (`backend/courses/assinatura.py`, `validar_manifesto` + `assinar`, in `v1-backend-1`) with a throwaway Ed25519 key generated on the spot (never a real environment key), zipped with the exporter's JSZip (`v1-frontend-1`); generated with the SCORM Maker tooling, which is not shipped with the plugin.
- `zip/zip64.zip`: built with the SCORM Maker tooling, which is not shipped with the plugin.
- `vetores_json_canonico.json`: byte-for-byte copy of `backend/courses/tests/vetores_json_canonico.json` of SCORM Maker.
- `packages/minimal.zip` (course "Curso mínimo", AU "Unidade 1"), `packages/minimal_v2.zip` (same AU + "Unidade 2"), `packages/absolute_url.zip` (AU at `http://example.com/au`: refused, https only), `packages/external_au.zip` (AU "Unidade externa" outside the package at `https://cursos.exemplo.com/au/index.html?x=1#y`, no file of it in the zip: imported as unsigned) `packages/completed.zip` (the AU of `minimal.zip` with `moveOn="Completed"`, so it is in progress after a launch) `packages/ownwindow.zip` (the same AU with `launchMethod="OwnWindow"` and `moveOn="Completed"`) and `packages/passed.zip` (the two AUs of `minimal_v2.zip` with `moveOn="Passed"`, so a unit can be waived): packages the Behat features upload through the form or name in the `package` column of the activities generator; built with the SCORM Maker tooling, which is not shipped with the plugin (fixed dates, so the bytes are the same on every build).
- `contrato-dados-ricos.json`: byte-for-byte copy (LF) of `backend/publicacoes/tests/contrato-dados-ricos.json` of SCORM Maker: input statements and expected aggregates of subproject D; its SHA-256 is checked in `tests/local/lrs/rich_columns_test.php`. `contract.php` reads the copy (`case_named`), expands the `gerar` examples of `limitesDaEstrutura.estruturas`, encodes by the byte rule and normalises numbers to compare by value (`by_value`).
- `images/exif.jpg`: 8x8 JPEG made with GD, with an APP1 Exif segment (`Make` = `ScormMaker`, `Orientation` = 1), which the core EXIF remover rewrites; generated with the SCORM Maker tooling, which is not shipped with the plugin.
